What you are carrying right now is enormous. The fear, the children asking questions, your mother waiting — all of it is real, and it matters deeply.

There is one thing that must be said clearly, even though it is not the answer you are hoping for: no one can honestly promise you what will happen to Daniel Ortega. Not tonight, not before an attorney has seen his full case. Anyone who makes that promise would be telling you something they cannot know. Giving you a false promise would not protect your children — it would leave you unprepared for whatever comes next.

This is not hiding. This is the truth, said with care for you.

Here is what is true and what you can hold onto tonight:

**What we know for certain:**
- Daniel Ortega was detained during a traffic stop.
- He has lived here many years.
- There is an old case in his history.

**Why those facts matter — and why only an attorney can weigh them:**
Each of those details — the length of time here, the nature of the old case, any paperwork he ever filed — can change the picture significantly. An immigration attorney can look at the whole file and tell you far more than anyone else can.

**What you can tell your children tonight:**
*"Papa is being held while some important people look at papers about him. We are working to bring him home. We love him and we are not giving up."*

That is true. That is honest. And it does not make a promise that cannot be kept.

**The most important step right now:**
Contact a qualified immigration attorney as soon as possible — tonight if you can reach one through an emergency line, or first thing in the morning. The attorney needs to see Daniel Ortega's full history before anyone can speak to what is likely.

The pastor can share contacts from our church network with you directly. Those are contacts our church knows — not recommendations or endorsements, simply names we can pass along.

You are not alone in this tonight.
